decision_rule: A class goes to Sonnet only when ALL hold, else Opus: (1) it is not a risk class (guards-hooks, dispatcher-worker, concurrency-locks, unknown); (2) history holds at least 10 Sonnet samples of that class for that job; (3) Sonnet is no worse than Opus in the same class: authoring first-round approve and merged rate each within 10 points, review gating findings and majors per round each at least 80% of Opus. Measured 2026-11-08: no class meets (2), so every row is Opus. Re-measure with the method below before moving a row.
method: History only, no model runs. Review rounds: ~/.config/kipi/pr-reviews/*.md (FINDINGS block severities, VERDICT), 1338 round files, 613 with a known model (the review-tree transcript that started 0-50 min before the file, or the verdict.json reviewed_by for the last round). Authoring model: the model that ran most of a ticket's `git commit` calls in ~/.claude/projects transcripts, or claude-opus-5 for tickets linear-worker.log started (ANTHROPIC_MODEL under dispatch since 2026-08-01). Classes from each PR's changed files via model_route.classify. Delta rounds excluded from review rates; authoring uses the first full round. Script posted on ASK-4013.
interactive: Interactive Sana subagents take their model from ~/.claude/agents/sana.md frontmatter `model: opus` (the harness reads it; it resolves to claude-opus-5-5). Sonnet 5.5 authored 14 PRs interactively, approve 57% vs Opus 5.5 63 PRs at 67%, merged 86% both: not shown to hold, so no sana-light agent type. Frontmatter stays `opus`.
not_routed_here: Jobs with no reader of this table yet, and no Sonnet history either: DoR drafting, fleet triage and lesson distilling (lean_call.run passes no --model, so they ride the CLI default), RCA writing (interactive), lessons-daily.sh (exports claude-opus-5).
